title: Dead Labrador Nelly photographed as a ball of light after a Cape Canaveral launch trip
place_text: Cape Canaveral, Florida; Fayetteville, North Carolina

tellings.quote: And she comes up out of her grave in a little ball of light. and I took that picture and that's how I got that.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man known for reporting UFO encounters, says that in 2007, after a trip to see a rocket launch at Cape Canaveral in Florida, he photographed his dead Labrador, Nelly, rising out of her grave as a small ball of light. In his words, "she comes up out of her grave in a little ball of light. and I took that picture." He tells it first-hand, mentions a man named Timothy Taylor, and points to his book UFO of God, and he offers it as a sign that something of a living being goes on after death.
